question: Which datasets are worth further publication work, and should the previous five-candidate shortlist expand to ten?
scope: Ten candidate products for qualification, preserving the global preference. This is an action ranking, not a new citation top ten or authorization to build/upload ten datasets.
ranking_criteria_in_order: Scientific identity/usefulness not satisfied by an interchangeable existing product
Incremental access value over current producer or third-party hosting
Local readiness and bounded implementation effort
Redistribution terms, source pinning and sustainable maintenance
Breadth of global use; prior associated-paper citations are supporting context only
promotion_rule: Start a new release only after checking exact product/version/statistic, existing useful hosting, rights, and reproducible validation. Existing cloud-native assets normally receive qualified registry links.
counterfactual: If a maintained matching publication meets the intended access pattern, change action to reuse, not conversion. No claim of hosting absence follows from an unsuccessful search.
overlap_rule: HydroLAKES and LakeATLAS have distinct scientific records but overlapping geometry. Evaluate the pair as one acquisition/geometry-validation effort, not two independent global inventories.
validation_scope: Documentation and metadata consistency; no full data downloads, GEE/cloud jobs, registry or publication mutations. No empirical accuracy or performance comparison.
